title: Panel negatives: line search, closing the WO, invoiced WO, no schedule, one site
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. Search for a line and confirm maintenance services are not returned (canned lines only).
  2. Confirm nothing in the panel blocks closing the work order.
  3. On an invoiced or paid work order, confirm Add Service is not offered (the (i) explains why) and Mark complete stays in the menu.
  4. Confirm an org with no schedule sees no maintenance card, and an org with one workplace never copies work.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Line search does not return maintenance services; adding a line returns canned lines only.
  • Nothing in the panel blocks closing the work order.
  • Add Service is not offered on a work order that is invoiced or paid (the row's (i) reads 'Lines can't be created on an invoiced work order'); Mark complete stays in its menu.
  • An organization with no maintenance schedule sees no maintenance card on a work order; an organization with one workplace never copies work.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-N2: “Line search does not return maintenance services. Adding a line returns canned lines only”
  • S16-N3: “Nothing in the panel blocks closing the work order”
  • S16-N7: “Add Service is not offered on a work order that is invoiced or paid, because adding lines there would void or reopen its invoice. The row's (i) reads Lines can't be created on an invoiced work order, and Mark complete stays in its menu”
  • S16-N8: “An organization with no maintenance schedule sees no maintenance card on a work order”
  • S16-N9: “An organization with one workplace never copies work. Every work order is at the home location”
